The Dutch '''[[Eredivisie]] in the 1959–60 season''' was contested by 18 teams. [[AFC Ajax]] won the championship, after a decision match against [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]] which was won by 5–1.

==Championship play-off==

{{OneLegStart}}
{{OneLegResult|'''[[AFC Ajax]]'''|| 5–1 |[[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]]||}}
{{end}}
[[AFC Ajax]] qualified for the [[1960–61 European Cup]].

==Relegation play-off==

{{OneLegStart}}
{{OneLegResult|'''[[USV Elinkwijk|Elinkwijk]]'''|| 1–0 |[[Blauw-Wit Amsterdam]]||}}
{{end}}
[[Blauw-Wit Amsterdam]] are relegated to [[1960–61 Eerste Divisie|Eerste Divisie]].

Note: No edition of the [[KNVB Cup]] was held this year.
